rows.speaker: Dominic
rows.en: All units have finished launching.
rows.display_text: 「All units have finished launching.」

rows.speaker: Anemone
rows.en: All right, the END! Since I'm the one riding you, I'll let you cut loose to your heart's content!
rows.display_text:
「All right, the END! Since I'm the one
riding you, I'll let you cut loose to your
heart's content!」

rows.speaker: Sting
rows.en: That's an odd-looking KLF. A custom unit?
rows.display_text:
「That's an odd-looking KLF. A custom
unit?」

rows.speaker: Anemone
rows.en: This one's the Nirvash type the END. It won't lose to anybody.
rows.display_text:
「This one's the Nirvash type the END. It
won't lose to anybody.」

rows.speaker: Schlan
rows.en: Nirvash... A machine that shares its name with the world's first LFO.
rows.display_text:
「Nirvash... A machine that shares its
name with the world's first LFO.」

rows.speaker: Dominic
rows.en: Anemone, this sortie doubles as a test run for the END. Don't push yourself too hard.
rows.display_text:
「Anemone, this sortie doubles as a test
run for the END. Don't push yourself too
hard.」

rows.speaker: Anemone
rows.en: Shut up, Dominic! Just sit there and watch me shine!
rows.display_text:
「Shut up, Dominic! Just sit there and
watch me shine!」

rows.speaker: Anemone
rows.en: And you'd better tell Lieutenant Colonel Dewey! Tell him how strong I am!
rows.display_text:
「And you'd better tell Lieutenant Colonel
Dewey! Tell him how strong I am!」

rows.speaker: Dominic
rows.en: A-all right.
rows.display_text: 「A-all right.」

rows.speaker: Kacricon
rows.en: So it seems the staff officer really is that little spitfire's guardian, after all.
rows.display_text:
「So it seems the staff officer really is
that little spitfire's guardian, after all.」

rows.speaker: Jerid
rows.en: Watch yourself, Kacricon. Our Gabthley is flying today as a test run too.
rows.display_text:
「Watch yourself, Kacricon. Our Gabthley
is flying today as a test run too.」

rows.speaker: Kacricon
rows.en: I know. ...Still, it's surprising a transformable machine like that was even developed.
rows.display_text:
「I know. ...Still, it's surprising a
transformable machine like that was even
developed.」

rows.speaker: Mouar
rows.en: I hear this Gabthley is a machine Colonel Scirocco designed himself.
rows.display_text:
「I hear this Gabthley is a machine
Colonel Scirocco designed himself.」

rows.speaker: Jerid
rows.en: You know a lot about it. Have you been with the Colonel long, Ensign?
rows.display_text:
「You know a lot about it. Have you been
with the Colonel long, Ensign?」

rows.speaker: Mouar
rows.en: No...

rows.speaker: Auel
rows.en: You think those Titans guys can handle a new model?
rows.display_text:
「You think those Titans guys can handle
a new model?」

rows.speaker: Sting
rows.en: They can do whatever they want over there. But both sides are three-man teams. We can't afford to lose.
rows.display_text:
「They can do whatever they want over
there. But both sides are three-man
teams. We can't afford to lose.」

rows.speaker: Auel
rows.en: I know, I know. Stella, you'd better pull your weight too.
rows.display_text:
「I know, I know. Stella, you'd better
pull your weight too.」

rows.speaker: Stella
rows.en: ...Okay.
rows.display_text: 「...Okay.」

rows.speaker: Lowen
rows.en: Everyone here is carrying the pride of their unit on their shoulders... We can't afford to lose either.
rows.display_text:
「Everyone here is carrying the pride of
their unit on their shoulders... We can't
afford to lose either.」

rows.speaker: Schlan
rows.en: Heh...

rows.speaker: Lowen
rows.en: Something wrong, Schlan?
rows.display_text: 「Something wrong, Schlan?」

rows.speaker: Schlan
rows.en: No... just do as you always do. As Chimera's young lion.
rows.display_text:
「No... just do as you always do. As
Chimera's young lion.」

rows.speaker: Lowen
rows.en: Right!
rows.display_text: 「Right!」

rows.speaker: Dominic
rows.en: All units, into interception formation! Enemy units are entering combat range!
rows.display_text:
「All units, into interception formation!
Enemy units are entering combat range!」

rows.speaker: AEUG Soldier
rows.en: Enemy confirmed...! They're already in interception formation!
rows.display_text:
「Enemy confirmed...! They're already in
interception formation!」

rows.speaker: ZAFT Soldier
rows.en: So that's the elite unit of the New Federation gathered together, just like the report said.
rows.display_text:
「So that's the elite unit of the New
Federation gathered together, just like
the report said.」

rows.speaker: Jurgens
rows.en: AEUG and ZAFT...!
rows.display_text: 「AEUG and ZAFT...!」

rows.speaker: Dominic
rows.en: Since they're attacking this base, it's safe to assume we're the target.
rows.display_text:
「Since they're attacking this base, it's
safe to assume we're the target.」

rows.speaker: Neo
rows.en: Attention, all units. You can see the situation for yourselves.
rows.display_text:
「Attention, all units. You can see the
situation for yourselves.」

rows.speaker: Neo
rows.en: If we get crushed before this unit's even formed, it'll be an embarrassment to the New Federation's finest. Don't slip up...!
rows.display_text:
「If we're crushed before this unit
forms, we'd shame the New Federation's
finest. Don't slip up...!」

rows.speaker: Lowen
rows.en: Understood!
rows.display_text: 「Understood!」

rows.speaker: Anemone
rows.en: You people...! I'll make you regret ever starting this!
rows.display_text:
「You people...! I'll make you regret ever
starting this!」

rows.speaker: Neo
rows.en: All units, begin the attack! Today, do as you please!
rows.display_text:
「All units, begin the attack! Today, do
as you please!」

rows.speaker: Neo
rows.en: Target time for mission completion is three minutes! If we struggle against opponents like this, I dread to think what's coming next!
rows.display_text:
「Target time is three minutes! Struggling
against foes like this doesn't bode well
for what's ahead!」

rows.speaker: Dominic
rows.en: Confirmed the enemy force has been wiped out.
rows.display_text:
「Confirmed the enemy force has been
wiped out.」

rows.speaker: Jurgens
rows.en: This kind of fighting... I suppose that's to be expected of them.
rows.display_text:
「This kind of fighting... I suppose that's
to be expected of them.」

rows.speaker: Neo
rows.en: Well done, everyone. Seems the higher-ups who picked us weren't blind after all.
rows.display_text:
「Well done, everyone. Seems the
higher-ups who picked us weren't blind
after all.」

rows.speaker: Neo
rows.en: Return to base. I'm issuing Special Order Code 013.
rows.display_text:
「Return to base. I'm issuing Special
Order Code 013.」

rows.speaker: Jerid
rows.en: Special Order Code 013?
rows.display_text: 「Special Order Code 013?」

rows.speaker: Neo
rows.en: It's the mission given to this unit. We're now the Special Task Force 013.
rows.display_text:
「It's the mission given to this unit.
We're now the Special Task Force 013.」

rows.speaker: Sting
rows.en: The Special Task Force 013, huh... Heh. What a bland, flavorless name.
rows.display_text:
「The Special Task Force 013, huh... Heh.
What a bland, flavorless name.」

rows.speaker: Neo
rows.en: I'll hear complaints later. Now... our fight begins.
rows.display_text:
「I'll hear complaints later. Now... our
fight begins.」

rows.speaker: Jurgens
rows.en: Prepare to fire! Don't let the enemy get close!
rows.display_text:
「Prepare to fire! Don't let the enemy
get close!」

rows.speaker: Jurgens
rows.en: If the flagship goes down before this unit's even formed, we'll be the laughingstock of the entire army!
rows.display_text:
「If the flagship goes down before this
unit forms, we'll be the laughingstock of
the whole army!」

rows.speaker: Dominic
rows.en: Colonel Dewey ordered me to join the special duty force for the sake of testing the END and Anemone...
rows.display_text:
（Colonel Dewey ordered me to join the
special duty force for the sake of
testing the END and Anemone...）

rows.speaker: Dominic
rows.en: The moment this unit's mission ends will probably be when Anemone's fight... and the Colonel's fight... truly begins...
rows.display_text:
（This unit's mission ending will probably
be when Anemone's... and the Colonel's
fight truly begins...）

rows.speaker: Anemone
rows.en: Dominic! Don't just stand there spacing out!
rows.display_text:
「Dominic! Don't just stand there spacing
out!」

rows.speaker: Anemone
rows.en: Make sure you report how amazing I was to Dewey! Got it!?
rows.display_text:
「Make sure you report how amazing I was
to Dewey! Got it!?」

rows.speaker: Dominic
rows.en: Y-yeah!
rows.display_text: 「Y-yeah!」

rows.speaker: Anemone
rows.en: All right, here I go! I'll make you the END's next meal!
rows.display_text:
「All right, here I go! I'll make you the
END's next meal!」

rows.speaker: Dominic
rows.en: Anemone...
rows.display_text: （Anemone...）

rows.speaker: Jerid
rows.en: If this unit really did gather the Federation's elite, then perfect...!
rows.display_text:
「If this unit really did gather the
Federation's elite, then perfect...!」

rows.speaker: Jerid
rows.en: I won't rely on the Titans' name anymore...! I'll prove my own strength!
rows.display_text:
「I won't rely on the Titans' name
anymore...! I'll prove my own strength!」

rows.speaker: Jerid
rows.en: Lila...! I'll show you I can be a real man!
rows.display_text:
「Lila...! I'll show you I can be a real
man!」

rows.speaker: Kacricon
rows.en: I've been through plenty in this multiverse too...!
rows.display_text:
「I've been through plenty in this
multiverse too...!」

rows.speaker: Kacricon
rows.en: I'll show you technique forged in real combat!
rows.display_text:
「I'll show you technique forged in real
combat!」

rows.speaker: Mouar
rows.en: Colonel Scirocco ordered me to judge whether Lt. Jerid and the others are any good...
rows.display_text:
（Colonel Scirocco ordered me to judge
whether Lt. Jerid and the others are any
good...）

rows.speaker: Mouar
rows.en: Jerid Messa... Let's see just what kind of man he is.
rows.display_text:
（Jerid Messa... Let's see just what kind
of man he is.）

rows.speaker: Neo
rows.en: Well... if I'm going to be the captain, I'd better show some skill worth the title...!
rows.display_text:
「Well... if I'm going to be the captain,
I'd better show some skill worth the
title...!」

rows.speaker: Neo
rows.en: I'll make sure no one says the name doesn't live up to the man!
rows.display_text:
「I'll make sure no one says the name
doesn't live up to the man!」

rows.speaker: Sting
rows.en: The higher-ups' expectations don't matter to me...! All that matters is whether I can do it or not!
rows.display_text:
「The higher-ups' expectations don't
matter to me...! All that matters is
whether I can do it or not!」

rows.speaker: Sting
rows.en: We're not allowed to lose! No matter who we're up against or where, we'll fight it out to the end!
rows.display_text:
「We're not allowed to lose! No matter
who we're up against or where, we'll fight
it out to the end!」

rows.speaker: Auel
rows.en: What a boring opponent...! I can't show off my real skill against something like this!
rows.display_text:
「What a boring opponent...! I can't show
off my real skill against something like
this!」

rows.speaker: Auel
rows.en: Let's wrap this up fast and get to hear about the real mission!
rows.display_text:
「Let's wrap this up fast and get to
hear about the real mission!」

rows.speaker: Stella
rows.en: Neo... Stella will do her best. Stella will fight...!
rows.display_text:
「Neo... Stella will do her best. Stella
will fight...!」

rows.speaker: Lowen
rows.en: If I win glory in battle, that glory becomes Chimera's own!
rows.display_text:
「If I win glory in battle, that glory
becomes Chimera's own!」

rows.speaker: Lowen
rows.en: General Edel...! I dedicate my fight to you and to the world's law and order!
rows.display_text:
「General Edel...! I dedicate my fight to
you and to the world's law and order!」

rows.speaker: Schlan
rows.en: Calling us an elite unit sounds nice enough, but in the end, we're just pieces moved for our superiors' convenience...
rows.display_text:
「Calling us elite sounds nice, but in the
end we're pieces moved for our superiors'
convenience...」

rows.speaker: Schlan
rows.en: Still, I'm grateful for this mission. Heh heh... let's enjoy ourselves.
rows.display_text:
「Still, I'm grateful for this mission. Heh
heh... let's enjoy ourselves.」

rows.speaker: Jerid
rows.en: Transfer...?
rows.display_text: 「Transfer...?」

rows.speaker: Jamaican
rows.en: That's right. Lt. Jerid and Lt. Kacricon, both of you are being transferred to the special duty force as of today.
rows.display_text:
「That's right. Lt. Jerid, Lt. Kacricon,
you're both transferred to the special
duty force today.」

rows.speaker: Kacricon
rows.en: Would that be regarding the new unit chasing after AEUG and ZAFT?
rows.display_text:
「Would that be regarding the new unit
chasing after AEUG and ZAFT?」

rows.speaker: Jerid
rows.en: In that case, it's exactly what I was hoping for.
rows.display_text:
「In that case, it's exactly what I was
hoping for.」

rows.speaker: Jerid
rows.en: Those people are reinforcing their strength by pulling in special machines meant to intercept the aliens, and anti-Federation gangs.
rows.display_text:
「They're building up strength by
absorbing anti-alien special machines and
anti-Federation gangs.」

rows.speaker: Jerid
rows.en: If we're going to strike them, the sooner the better.
rows.display_text:
「If we're going to strike them, the
sooner the better.」

rows.speaker: Jamaican
rows.en: Calm down, Lieutenant. ...The rest of the briefing will come from the officer in charge of the special duty force.
rows.display_text:
「Calm down, Lieutenant. ...The rest comes
from the officer in charge of the special
duty force.」

rows.speaker: Scirocco
rows.en: Well done, Major Jamaican. I'll take it from here.
rows.display_text:
「Well done, Major Jamaican. I'll take it
from here.」

rows.speaker: Jamaican
rows.en: Understood. Then, if you'll excuse me.
rows.display_text: 「Understood. Then, if you'll excuse me.」

rows.speaker: Scirocco
rows.en: Do let Colonel Bask know I appreciate him lending us one of his ace pilots directly under his command.
rows.display_text:
「Do let Colonel Bask know I appreciate
him lending us one of his ace pilots
directly under his command.」

rows.speaker: Jamaican
rows.en: Scirocco... Riding on the Chairman's authority, getting full of himself... Just you wait...
rows.display_text:
（Scirocco... Riding on the Chairman's
authority, getting full of himself... Just
you wait...）

rows.speaker: Kacricon
rows.en: So that's him... the man back from Jupiter, recruited by Chairman Jamitov. Paptimus Scirocco.
rows.display_text:
（So that's him... the man back from
Jupiter, recruited by Chairman Jamitov.
Paptimus Scirocco.）

rows.speaker: Jerid
rows.en: If he's been put in charge of the special duty force, I bet Colonel Bask finds that less than amusing.
rows.display_text:
（If he's been put in charge of the
special duty force, I bet Colonel Bask
finds that less than amusing.）

rows.speaker: Scirocco
rows.en: Lt. Jerid, Lt. Kacricon, sorry for the sudden notice, but...
rows.display_text:
「Lt. Jerid, Lt. Kacricon, sorry for the
sudden notice, but...」

rows.speaker: Scirocco
rows.en: The two of you will be transferred to the special duty force, along with Ensign Mouar here.
rows.display_text:
「The two of you will be transferred to
the special duty force, along with Ensign
Mouar here.」

rows.speaker: Mouar
rows.en: I'm Ensign Mouar Pharaoh. Pleased to meet you.
rows.display_text:
「I'm Ensign Mouar Pharaoh. Pleased to
meet you.」

rows.speaker: Scirocco
rows.en: She's an excellent pilot. I'm sure she'll make a fine team with you two.
rows.display_text:
「She's an excellent pilot. I'm sure she'll
make a fine team with you two.」

rows.speaker: Jerid
rows.en: So then, Colonel... is the special duty force's mission to pursue AEUG's Argama?
rows.display_text:
「So then, Colonel... is the special duty
force's mission to pursue AEUG's Argama?」

rows.speaker: Scirocco
rows.en: ...As you both know, the joint AEUG-ZAFT force has allied with various factions and formed an armed organization.
rows.display_text:
「...As you both know, AEUG-ZAFT's force
allied with various factions, forming an
armed group.」

rows.speaker: Scirocco
rows.en: Its name is $c... In time, it will likely become a considerable obstacle for us.
rows.display_text:
「Its name is $c... In time, it will likely
become a considerable obstacle for us.」

rows.speaker: Jerid
rows.en: Then the special duty force's mission really is to wipe them out?
rows.display_text:
「Then the special duty force's mission
really is to wipe them out?」

rows.speaker: Scirocco
rows.en: I said 'in time.' Until then, we can afford to let them run free.
rows.display_text:
「I said 'in time.' Until then, we can
afford to let them run free.」

rows.speaker: Scirocco
rows.en: Your new posting will become the forerunner of the unit that hunts down $c, but for now, your task will be something else.
rows.display_text:
「Your new post precedes the unit
hunting $c, but for now you've another
task.」

rows.speaker: Jerid
rows.en: You're saying there's someone we should prioritize over them?
rows.display_text:
「You're saying there's someone we should
prioritize over them?」

rows.speaker: Scirocco
rows.en: Follow me. The details are better heard from the field commander than from me.
rows.display_text:
「Follow me. The details are better heard
from the field commander than from me.」

rows.speaker: Scirocco
rows.en: Besides, I still have to introduce you to the rest of the members.
rows.display_text:
「Besides, I still have to introduce you
to the rest of the members.」

rows.speaker: Scirocco
rows.en: ...This special duty force was formed by gathering the elite of each unit -- you among them.
rows.display_text:
「...This special duty force was formed
by gathering the elite of each unit --
you among them.」

rows.speaker: Scirocco
rows.en: The higher-ups have high hopes for this unit as well. Good luck out there.
rows.display_text:
「The higher-ups have high hopes for this
unit as well. Good luck out there.」

rows.speaker: Auel
rows.en: Question~! Forget the hopes and all that, just tell us what the mission actually is already.
rows.display_text:
「Question~! Forget the hopes and all
that, just tell us what the mission
actually is already.」

rows.speaker: Jurgens
rows.en: Questions to superiors require permission first. And what's with that tone of voice...!?
rows.display_text:
「Questions to superiors require
permission first. And what's with that
tone of voice...!?」

rows.speaker: Neo
rows.en: My apologies, Captain Jurgens. ...And you as well, Colonel Scirocco. My subordinate's rudeness is my responsibility as his superior.
rows.display_text:
「My apologies, Capt. Jurgens, Col.
Scirocco. My subordinate's rudeness is on
me, his superior.」

rows.speaker: Scirocco
rows.en: Good attitude, Colonel Neo Roanoke. You're the one I can trust with a group like this.
rows.display_text:
「Good attitude, Colonel Neo Roanoke.
You're the one I can trust with a group
like this.」

rows.speaker: Neo
rows.en: I'm honored.
rows.display_text: 「I'm honored.」

rows.speaker: Scirocco
rows.en: Now then, I'll leave the details of the mission to the man on the ground.
rows.display_text:
「Now then, I'll leave the details of the
mission to the man on the ground.」

rows.speaker: Scirocco
rows.en: To repeat myself, I'm counting on all of you to perform well. ...Now then, Colonel Roanoke... it's yours.
rows.display_text:
「To repeat, I'm counting on all of you
to perform well. ...Now then, Colonel
Roanoke... it's yours.」

rows.speaker: Neo
rows.en: The higher-ups' hopes, huh... They sure make it sound easy, throwing together a bunch of characters this eccentric.
rows.display_text:
（The higher-ups' hopes, huh... Easy for
them to say, throwing together such an
eccentric bunch.）

rows.speaker: Dominic
rows.en: Colonel Roanoke, before the mission briefing, I'd suggest we introduce ourselves to one another.
rows.display_text:
「Colonel Roanoke, before the mission
briefing, I'd suggest we introduce
ourselves to one another.」

rows.speaker: Neo
rows.en: Good idea. We're going to be eating out of the same pot from now on. Can't get anywhere without knowing each other first.
rows.display_text:
「Good idea. We're comrades now. Can't
start without knowing each other first.」

rows.speaker: Neo
rows.en: All right, I'll go first...
rows.display_text: 「All right, I'll go first...」

rows.speaker: Neo
rows.en: Formerly captain of Phantom Pain, under the 81st Independent Mobile Group of the Earth Alliance Forces -- Colonel Neo Roanoke.
rows.display_text:
「Ex-Phantom Pain's captain, 81st Indep.
Mobile Group, Earth Alliance -- Col. Neo
Roanoke.」

rows.speaker: Neo
rows.en: I'll be serving as field commander for this special duty force. Good to work with you all.
rows.display_text:
「I'll be serving as field commander for
this special duty force. Good to work
with you all.」

rows.speaker: Anemone
rows.en: What's with that mask? Trying to look stylish?
rows.display_text:
「What's with that mask? Trying to look
stylish?」

rows.speaker: Dominic
rows.en: A-Anemone...! Asking about someone's private matters like that...
rows.display_text:
「A-Anemone...! Asking about someone's
private matters like that...」

rows.speaker: Neo
rows.en: It's fine. It's only natural to be curious.
rows.display_text:
「It's fine. It's only natural to be
curious.」

rows.speaker: Neo
rows.en: This has been with me ever since I took a serious head injury in a past battle.
rows.display_text:
「This has been with me ever since I
took a serious head injury in a past
battle.」

rows.speaker: Neo
rows.en: It leaves some gaps in my memory, but it doesn't get in the way of command or combat. So don't worry about that.
rows.display_text:
「It leaves gaps in my memory, but
doesn't hinder command or combat. Don't
worry about it.」

rows.speaker: Anemone
rows.en: Huh... you didn't dodge the question, you actually answered it straight. I think I like you, Captain.
rows.display_text:
「Huh... you didn't dodge the question,
you actually answered it straight. I think
I like you, Captain.」

rows.speaker: Neo
rows.en: Glad to hear it. ...Now, these are the men who've been under me from before.
rows.display_text:
「Glad to hear it. ...Now, these are the
men who've been under me from before.」

rows.speaker: Sting
rows.en: Sting Oakley. I pilot the Chaos.
rows.display_text: 「Sting Oakley. I pilot the Chaos.」

rows.speaker: Auel
rows.en: Auel Neider. I pilot the Abyss. You don't need to bother being nice to me, by the way.
rows.display_text:
「Auel Neider. I pilot the Abyss. You
don't need to bother being nice to me, by
the way.」

rows.speaker: Anemone
rows.en: What's with you? Can't you talk or something?
rows.display_text:
「What's with you? Can't you talk or
something?」

rows.speaker: Neo
rows.en: That's Stella Loussier. She's just a little out of sorts right now.
rows.display_text:
「That's Stella Loussier. She's just a
little out of sorts right now.」

rows.speaker: Jerid
rows.en: Captain, don't these two have ranks?
rows.display_text: 「Captain, don't these two have ranks?」

rows.speaker: Sting
rows.en: 'These two'...?
rows.display_text: 「'These two'...?」

rows.speaker: Auel
rows.en: We don't need any of that. Guess the Titans -- so in love with rank and privilege -- wouldn't understand.
rows.display_text:
「We don't need any of that. Guess the
Titans -- so in love with rank and
privilege -- wouldn't understand.」

rows.speaker: Jerid
rows.en: What did you say...!?
rows.display_text: 「What did you say...!?」

rows.speaker: Kacricon
rows.en: Cut it out, Jerid. ...We're going to be in the same unit from now on. Don't go starting unnecessary fights.
rows.display_text:
「Cut it out, Jerid. ...We're in the same
unit now. Don't start unnecessary fights.」

rows.speaker: Jerid
rows.en: Yeah, I know.
rows.display_text: 「Yeah, I know.」

rows.speaker: Jerid
rows.en: It's this kind of world now. As long as you've got the skill, rank doesn't matter one way or another.
rows.display_text:
「It's this kind of world now. As long as
you've got the skill, rank doesn't matter
one way or another.」

rows.speaker: Auel
rows.en: Huh... you're surprisingly easygoing for a Titans guy.
rows.display_text:
「Huh... you're surprisingly easygoing for
a Titans guy.」

rows.speaker: Neo
rows.en: Auel, that's enough needling too. ...Sorry about that, Lieutenant. If I offended you, I'll apologize on his behalf.
rows.display_text:
「Auel, enough needling too. ...Sorry,
Lieutenant. If offended, I'll apologize for
him.」

rows.speaker: Jerid
rows.en: It's fine. I never thought I could get by on the Titans name alone anyway.
rows.display_text:
「It's fine. I never thought I could get
by on the Titans name alone anyway.」

rows.speaker: Neo
rows.en: Hoh...

rows.speaker: Jerid
rows.en: So I intend to show these two what I'm made of, in actual combat.
rows.display_text:
「So I intend to show these two what I'm
made of, in actual combat.」

rows.speaker: Sting
rows.en: Big talk.
rows.display_text: 「Big talk.」

rows.speaker: Jerid
rows.en: Let me introduce myself properly. I'm Jerid Messa.
rows.display_text:
「Let me introduce myself properly. I'm
Jerid Messa.」

rows.speaker: Jerid
rows.en: This is Kacricon Cacooler. And that's Mouar Pharaoh.
rows.display_text:
「This is Kacricon Cacooler. And that's
Mouar Pharaoh.」

rows.speaker: Kacricon
rows.en: So, what about the pink young lady over there? She doesn't look much like military personnel...
rows.display_text:
「So, what about the pink young lady
over there? She doesn't look much like
military personnel...」

rows.speaker: Anemone
rows.en: That sounded kind of condescending...!
rows.display_text: 「That sounded kind of condescending...!」

rows.speaker: Dominic
rows.en: Her name is Anemone. She's a KLF rider trained by a special institution.
rows.display_text:
「Her name is Anemone. She's a KLF rider
trained by a special institution.」

rows.speaker: Kacricon
rows.en: Are you her guardian?
rows.display_text: 「Are you her guardian?」

rows.speaker: Dominic
rows.en: I'm Special Duty Captain Dominic Sorel. I'll be joining this unit as staff officer.
rows.display_text:
「I'm Special Duty Captain Dominic Sorel.
I'll be joining this unit as staff officer.」

rows.speaker: Kacricon
rows.en: My apologies...! I didn't realize you were a captain.
rows.display_text:
「My apologies...! I didn't realize you
were a captain.」

rows.speaker: Dominic
rows.en: Don't worry about it. This unit is made up of people gathered from all sorts of postings.
rows.display_text:
「Don't worry about it. This unit is made
up of people gathered from all sorts of
postings.」

rows.speaker: Dominic
rows.en: Let's not get too hung up on rank or position, and just keep things casual.
rows.display_text:
「Let's not get too hung up on rank or
position, and just keep things casual.」

rows.speaker: Jurgens
rows.en: Understood, Special Duty Captain. In that case, I'd ask that you not interfere with my command out in the field.
rows.display_text:
「Understood, Special Duty Captain. Then
I'd ask you not interfere with my
command in the field.」

rows.speaker: Dominic
rows.en: ...As long as the captain's command is sound, I have no intention of doing so.
rows.display_text:
「...As long as the captain's command is
sound, I have no intention of doing so.」

rows.speaker: Mouar
rows.en: Captain, you say...?
rows.display_text: 「Captain, you say...?」

rows.speaker: Jurgens
rows.en: I'm Jurgens. Captain of the Izumo, the mother ship of this unit. Pleased to work with you.
rows.display_text:
「I'm Jurgens. Captain of the Izumo, the
mother ship of this unit. Pleased to work
with you.」

rows.speaker: Lowen
rows.en: Well then, I suppose we're last.
rows.display_text: 「Well then, I suppose we're last.」

rows.speaker: Lowen
rows.en: I'm Captain Lowen General, of the 23rd Independent Unit, Chimera.
rows.display_text:
「I'm Captain Lowen General, of the 23rd
Independent Unit, Chimera.」

rows.speaker: Schlan
rows.en: Likewise, Captain Schlan Opel.
rows.display_text: 「Likewise, Captain Schlan Opel.」

rows.speaker: Jurgens
rows.en: Chimera...? Never heard of that unit.
rows.display_text: 「Chimera...? Never heard of that unit.」

rows.speaker: Lowen
rows.en: We've served as a special unit directly under General Edel Bernal, mainly handling the laying of UN infrastructure.
rows.display_text:
「We've served directly under General Edel
Bernal as a special unit, mainly laying UN
infrastructure.」

rows.speaker: Neo
rows.en: So you're on rear infrastructure duty, then.
rows.display_text:
「So you're on rear infrastructure duty,
then.」

rows.speaker: Lowen
rows.en: Yes. But I don't intend to be a burden to anyone on the front lines either.
rows.display_text:
「Yes. But I don't intend to be a burden
to anyone on the front lines either.」

rows.speaker: Neo
rows.en: Understood, Captain. Not to steal Lt. Jerid's line, but go ahead and prove that out in the field.
rows.display_text:
「Understood, Captain. Not to steal Lt.
Jerid's line, but go ahead and prove that
out in the field.」

rows.speaker: Jerid
rows.en: But with this bunch, what exactly are they going to have us do?
rows.display_text:
「But with this bunch, what exactly are
they going to have us do?」

rows.speaker: Jurgens
rows.en: If it's called a 'special duty force,' I'd assume it was put together to carry out some particular mission...
rows.display_text:
「If it's a 'special duty force,' I'd
assume it exists for some particular
mission...」

rows.speaker: Neo
rows.en: I'll let you know now, this isn't everyone.
rows.display_text:
「I'll let you know now, this isn't
everyone.」

rows.speaker: Neo
rows.en: Civilian collaborators, and crew members whose machines are still being adjusted, are supposed to join us later.
rows.display_text:
「Civilian collaborators, and crew whose
machines are still being adjusted, are
supposed to join us later.」

rows.speaker: Auel
rows.en: I don't care about any of that, just tell us the mission already.
rows.display_text:
「I don't care about any of that, just
tell us the mission already.」

rows.speaker: Neo
rows.en: The mission handed down to us comes directly from the higher-ups. It's not something to be discussed so lightly.
rows.display_text:
「Our mission comes directly from the
higher-ups. Not something to discuss
lightly.」

rows.speaker: Lowen
rows.en: Is this alarm an enemy attack...!?
rows.display_text: 「Is this alarm an enemy attack...!?」

rows.speaker: Schlan
rows.en: Seems our movements have been spotted. The enemy's likely AEUG or ZAFT.
rows.display_text:
「Seems our movements have been spotted.
The enemy's likely AEUG or ZAFT.」

rows.speaker: Neo
rows.en: All units, launch. If the enemy's after us, we'll have to deal with them.
rows.display_text:
「All units, launch. If the enemy's after
us, we'll have to deal with them.」

rows.speaker: Dominic
rows.en: But, Captain...! We haven't even finalized the platoon formations or confirmed our tactics yet...
rows.display_text:
「But, Captain...! We haven't even
finalized the platoon formations or
confirmed our tactics yet...」

rows.speaker: Neo
rows.en: This unit hasn't officially been formed yet. We're less than a team.
rows.display_text:
「This unit hasn't officially been formed
yet. We're less than a team.」

rows.speaker: Neo
rows.en: So today, it's every man for himself. Everyone, put the skill that got you picked for the special duty force to full use.
rows.display_text:
「So today's every man for himself. Make
full use of the skill that got you picked
for this special duty force.」

rows.speaker: Jerid
rows.en: Just what I wanted...! Let's go, Kacricon, Ensign Mouar!
rows.display_text:
「Just what I wanted...! Let's go,
Kacricon, Ensign Mouar!」

rows.speaker: Neo
rows.en: ...First, let's be glad everyone's safe. Well done, all of you.
rows.display_text:
「...First, let's be glad everyone's safe.
Well done, all of you.」

rows.speaker: Kacricon
rows.en: So, Captain... how did our assessment go?
rows.display_text:
「So, Captain... how did our assessment
go?」

rows.speaker: Neo
rows.en: What do you mean by that, Lieutenant?
rows.display_text: 「What do you mean by that, Lieutenant?」

rows.speaker: Kacricon
rows.en: No need to play dumb. Letting us fight however we wanted was to test our ability, wasn't it?
rows.display_text:
「No need to play dumb. Letting us fight
however we wanted was to test our
ability, wasn't it?」

rows.speaker: Neo
rows.en: So you saw right through it...
rows.display_text: 「So you saw right through it...」

rows.speaker: Neo
rows.en: The lieutenant's right. Sorry to say, but I used that last battle to size up everyone's skill.
rows.display_text:
「The lieutenant's right. Sorry to say,
but I used that last battle to size up
everyone's skill.」

rows.speaker: Neo
rows.en: Depending on the results, I was regrettably prepared to ask some of you to leave.
rows.display_text:
「Depending on the results, I was
regrettably prepared to ask some of you
to leave.」

rows.speaker: Sting
rows.en: Tch...! So even we got tested, huh, this late in the game.
rows.display_text:
「Tch...! So even we got tested, huh, this
late in the game.」

rows.speaker: Neo
rows.en: This unit gathers the New Federation's elite. If the members are carrying a name too heavy for them, it's the captain -- me -- who ends up paying for it.
rows.display_text:
「This unit's the New Federation's elite.
If a member's unworthy of that name, it
burdens me as captain.」

rows.speaker: Jerid
rows.en: So how'd the test turn out, Captain?
rows.display_text: 「So how'd the test turn out, Captain?」

rows.speaker: Neo
rows.en: Goes without saying. Everyone passed.
rows.display_text: 「Goes without saying. Everyone passed.」

rows.speaker: Anemone
rows.en: Well... looks like you're just barely good enough not to slow me down.
rows.display_text:
「Well... looks like you're just barely
good enough not to slow me down.」

rows.speaker: Auel
rows.en: How full of yourself can you get!?
rows.display_text: 「How full of yourself can you get!?」

rows.speaker: Anemone
rows.en: Hah! You want a piece of me!?
rows.display_text: 「Hah! You want a piece of me!?」

rows.speaker: Lowen
rows.en: C-come on, you two, cut it out. We're fighting in the same unit starting today.
rows.display_text:
「C-come on, you two, cut it out. We're
fighting in the same unit starting today.」

rows.speaker: Anemone
rows.en: What's your problem...! Stay out of it!
rows.display_text: 「What's your problem...! Stay out of it!」

rows.speaker: Lowen
rows.en: I-I didn't mean anything like that... it's just...
rows.display_text:
「I-I didn't mean anything like that...
it's just...」

rows.speaker: Anemone
rows.en: That's funny...! You're the one who picked the fight, and now you're scared of me?
rows.display_text:
「That's funny...! You're the one who
picked the fight, and now you're scared
of me?」

rows.speaker: Lowen
rows.en: T-that's... um...
rows.display_text: 「T-that's... um...」

rows.speaker: Schlan
rows.en: That's enough, Anemone. We have work to do.
rows.display_text:
「That's enough, Anemone. We have work
to do.」

rows.speaker: Neo
rows.en: The captain's right. I don't mind you two sparring within the unit, but keep it within reason.
rows.display_text:
「The captain's right. I don't mind you
two sparring within the unit, but keep it
within reason.」

rows.speaker: Schlan
rows.en: Well then, Captain... now that the test is over, why don't you tell us our mission?
rows.display_text:
「Well then, Captain... now that the test
is over, why don't you tell us our
mission?」

rows.speaker: Neo
rows.en: ...Very well. I'm issuing Special Order Code 013 to all of you as well.
rows.display_text:
「...Very well. I'm issuing Special Order
Code 013 to all of you as well.」

rows.speaker: Jurgens
rows.en: So it's finally time...
rows.display_text: 「So it's finally time...」

rows.speaker: Jerid
rows.en: Special orders... our mission...
rows.display_text: （Special orders... our mission...）

rows.speaker: Auel
rows.en: Oh, I like this... Getting me all excited...
rows.display_text:
（Oh, I like this... Getting me all
excited...）

rows.speaker: Neo
rows.en: The following mission is given to the newly formed special duty force.
rows.display_text:
「The following mission is given to the
newly formed special duty force.」

rows.speaker: Neo
rows.en: One: track the unidentified 'BG.' Two: capture, or shoot down, 'BG.'
rows.display_text:
「One: track the unidentified 'BG.'
Two: capture, or shoot down, 'BG.'」

rows.speaker: Sting
rows.en: If we're supposed to shoot it down, that at least makes it an enemy of the New Federation.
rows.display_text:
「If we're supposed to shoot it down,
that at least makes it an enemy of the
New Federation.」

rows.speaker: Neo
rows.en: BG is short for Black Gale.
rows.display_text: 「BG is short for Black Gale.」

rows.speaker: Neo
rows.en: Our mission -- the Special Task Force 013's mission -- is to track down, capture, or shoot down the mysterious, elusive machine known as BG.
rows.display_text:
「Special Task Force 013's mission:
track, capture, or shoot down the
mysterious, elusive machine, BG.」

rows.speaker: Jerid
rows.en: Black Gale... the black gust...
rows.display_text: 「Black Gale... the black gust...」
